definition: to come from a time long ago
description: A modern city square on a sunny day, with glass office towers and a tram behind. In the middle stands a tall, cracked ancient marble column with a pigeon on top. Around its base the pavement is a glass floor, and under the glass lie old stone paving and a patterned mosaic. A young woman in a dark red outfit kneels and looks down through the glass, and a man stands with a hand on the column. A young man in a blue shirt jumps a skateboard onto the glass and rolls past her as the pigeon flies away.
